phase_0.boundary_condition: the completed derivation trace from source expression to target expression, fixed by Z2-protected topological invariants

VINIT.justification: the void before any symbolic expression is loaded; no derivation state exists

TANCH.justification: the final fixed expression that closes the system; no further rewrites apply

AFWD.justification: a single rule application that transforms the expression toward the target form

AREV.justification: reversal of a rewrite when a branch fails to converge; restores prior expression

CLINK.justification: chains consecutive rewrites into a continuous derivation path

IMSCRIB.justification: a subexpression that rewrites to itself; self-recognition in the derivation

FSPLIT.justification: duplicates the current expression state for parallel exploration of applicable rewrite rules

FFUSE.justification: merges parallel derivation branches; identity holds only when all branches converge to identical expressions

EVALT.justification: affirmative: the selected rewrite rule applies at the current position

EVALF.justification: negative: the selected rewrite rule does not match; alternative rule must be tried

ENGAGR.justification: paradice: two rules match simultaneously creating overlapping rewrites; both held without resolution until confluence check

IFIX.justification: permanent append-only record of a committed rewrite in the derivation trace

phase_3.void_description: no expression loaded; derivation workspace uninitialized
phase_3.true_description: rewrite rule matched; derivation advances along this branch
phase_3.false_description: rewrite rule failed; derivation must backtrack or try alternative
phase_3.both_description: critical pair encountered; overlapping rewrites both held pending confluence verification

steps.domain_action: record initial source expression as derivation origin
fork derivation state for parallel rule exploration at first rewrite position
test primary rewrite rule (dimensionality propagation ⊢→⊣) on T-arm
apply dimensionality rule; transform local ⊢ context to ⊣ containment
compose this rewrite into derivation chain
test alternative rule (polarity complement <→>) on F-arm
backtrack; restore expression before failed polarity rewrite
join T-arm and F-arm; both converge to same expression after primary rule succeeds
fork again at next rewrite position (kinetic barrier ⊤ resolution)
test barrier crossing rule on T-arm
apply external driving to overcome kinetic freeze; ⊤ transitions to active state
backtrack; spontaneous transition fails high barrier
join arms; convergence on driven transition
fork at mesoscale propagation point (∈ cluster expansion)
test correlated cluster propagation on T-arm
propagate correlated clusters through recurrent interaction pathways
critical pair detected; two propagation pathways overlap (paradice state)
neither pathway resolves alone; confluence required
join with paradice unresolved; both pathways held
fork at sequential engagement point (∋ ordered recruitment)
test ordered partner recruitment on T-arm
recruit next partner in sequence; enforce temporal progression
fork at chiral symmetry breaking point (⊥ orientational memory)
test symmetry breaking commitment on T-arm
establish irreversible orientational axis; lock chiral direction
backtrack; symmetry cannot be restored once broken
fork at asymmetric participation check (⊞ varying contexts)
test asymmetric role assignment on T-arm
assign distinct donor/acceptor roles per context
backtrack; symmetric pairing contradicts context variance
fork at critical threshold verification (⊙ scale-free correlations)
self-reference; system recognizes its own critical state
confirm maximal sensitivity; correlations span all scales
fork at final target expression match
backtrack; mismatch would require further rewrites
join arms; T-arm succeeds, F-arm empty; derivation sealed
close system; sealed derivation trace contains complete transformation from source to target

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the rewrite rule engine that translates topological invariants into applicable transformation steps
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: symbolic pattern matching between expression subterms and rule left-hand sides
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the derivation trace stack storing each committed expression state and its rewrite history
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the confluence checker that orders parallel branch exploration and resolves critical pairs
phase_5.alfs_store: the canonical topological algebra defining Z2-protected primitives and their interaction grammar

phase_6.cycle_cost: one rewrite rule evaluation per cycle
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: expression state with n unresolved rewrite positions
phase_6.post_cycle_state: expression state with n-1 unresolved positions (or n+1 if critical pair expands)
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — each committed rewrite reduces topological complexity by one invariant; backtracks and critical pairs are transient and cancel in the sealed trace

grounding_reasoning:
⊢=𐑼: The primitive ⊢ (dimensionality) assigned to a point-like operator indicates the constraint propagation operates locally on a single unit without spatial extension.
⊣=𐑰: The topology primitive ⊣ assigned to containment hierarchy indicates a nested, branched structure where partners enter and operate within layered containers.
>=𐑑: The dense interleaving of directional markers (⊢, ⊣) with structural operators (⊞, ⊙, ◻, ⋈) indicates irreversible bond formation and topological restructuring rather than reversible association or catalytic stabilization.
<=𐑿: The primitive < is assigned as the polarity complement to > (𐑑), establishing a signed directional interface with distinct donating and accepting poles.
⋈=𐑞: The symbol ⋈ appears in structured sequences alongside geometric delimiters like ◻ and ⊞, suggesting context-dependent firing within a constrained topology rather than random or fully deterministic activation.
⊤=𐑧: The assignment of ⊤ as kinetic_character indicates a high barrier where the system is kinetically frozen and requires external driving to rearrange.
∈=𐑚: The dense interleaving of directional operators (⊢, ⊣, >, <) with structural motifs (⋈, ⊤) creates correlated clusters spanning tens to hundreds of units, enabling mesoscale propagation through recurrent interaction pathways.
∋=𐑠: The interaction grammar ∋ governs sequential engagement where partners are recruited in ordered steps, as evidenced by the nested directional operators (<, >) and state transitions (⊤, ⊥) that enforce temporal progression in the input stream.
⊙=⊙: The system is at the critical threshold exhibiting scale-free correlations and maximal sensitivity.
⊥=𐑖: The system exhibits persistent chiral symmetry breaking with multiple structurally enforced axes, as indicated by the complex nesting of directional operators (⊢, ⊣, >, <) and topological markers (⋈, ⊤, ⊥) that create irreversible orientational memory across scales.
⊞=𐑳: The symbol ⊞ appears in contexts with varying surrounding symbols and directional markers, indicating asymmetric participation rather than symmetric pairing or higher-order symmetric oligomers.
◻=𐑴: The primitive ◻ is assigned Z2-protection, meaning the role cannot be continuously deformed away without crossing a Z2 topological boundary.
